pages.title: Topological Logic Wafer
pages.text: A wafer of braided anyons: quasiparticles whose exchange paths store information in the topology of their braids. Errors cannot touch them, because no small disturbance can untie a braid. Its surface carries a faint woven pattern.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Quantum Lithographer, a Topological Wafer engraved through Quantum-Dot Photoresist produced anyons at the edges. Braiding them by moving the light, I wrote logic into their paths.
Made in $(item)Quantum Lithographer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Topological Matter.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Topological Die, Warm Helium.
